review_candidates.title: Assistant Manager Accounts Payable
review_candidates.description: Job Summary The Assistant Manager, Finance Operations supports day-to-day transactional and operational finance services, ensuring accurate execution, effective internal controls, process standardization and continuous improvement. The role supports the Finance Operations Senior Manager and/or Finance Operations Manager in coordinating Accounts Payable (AP), Travel & Expense (T&E), Intercompany Accounting, Fixed Asset Accounting, Lease Accounting and Finance Query Management. The incumbent is responsible for operational execution, issue resolution, stakeholder support, team coordination and achievement of agreed service level commitments within a shared services environment. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. Finance Operations Management • Support the day-to-day operations of Finance Operations activities and coordinate team execution. • Ensure processes are executed accurately, efficiently and in accordance with established policies and procedures. • Monitor operational performance, productivity, service quality and customer satisfaction. • Track service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs), escalating risks and gaps as required. • Support operational governance, issue resolution and escalation management. • Coordinate ERP master data maintenance activities, ensuring timely, accurate and controlled updates to supplier, customer, employee and finance-related master data. 2. Accounts Payable (AP) – End-to-End • Support AP activities, including invoice receipt, validation, processing, payment support and vendor account maintenance. • Ensure timely processing of invoices and supplier payments. • Coordinate payment runs and support exception management in line with approved controls. • Monitor AP aging, blocked invoices and overdue payments. • Partner with Procurement and Business Units to resolve invoice matching and payment issues. • Ensure compliance with tax, procurement and financial control requirements. 3. Travel & Expense (T&E) • Support expense claims processing and employee reimbursement activities. • Ensure compliance with corporate travel and expense policies. • Support corporate credit card administration and reconciliations. • Monitor expense claim turnaround times and policy exception rates. • Drive employee awareness and policy adherence. 4. Intercompany Accounting • Support monthly and quarterly intercompany reconciliation and settlement activities. • Ensure timely confirmation and resolution of intercompany mismatches. • Coordinate with finance teams to clear aged intercompany balances and resolve open items. • Support intercompany agreement governance and transfer pricing requirements. • Ensure accurate reporting and elimination support during close activities. 5. Fixed Asset Accounting • Support asset capitalization, transfers, disposals and depreciation activities. • Ensure integrity and completeness of fixed asset registers. • Coordinate periodic asset verification exercises. • Support capital expenditure governance and reporting. • Ensure compliance with accounting standards and company policies. 6. Lease Accounting • Support lease accounting activities in accordance with IFRS 16 / MFRS 16 requirements. • Maintain lease schedules and accounting records. • Ensure completeness and accuracy of lease data. • Review lease modifications and reassessments. • Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end reporting requirements. 7. Bank Reconciliation • Perform daily, weekly and monthly bank reconciliations for assigned bank accounts. • Match bank statement transactions against general ledger records. • Investigate, analyse and resolve reconciliation differences and outstanding items promptly. • Follow up with internal stakeholders and banks to clear unreconciled transactions. • Ensure reconciliation activities comply with established SOPs and internal controls. 8. Controls, Risk & Compliance • Maintain strong internal controls and segregation of duties. • Ensure readiness for internal and external audits. • Identify operational risks and implement mitigation measures. • Ensure compliance with policies, accounting standards and regulatory requirements. • Support SOX/internal control testing where applicable. 9. Continuous Improvement & Transformation • Support automation, standardization and process simplification initiatives. • Leverage ERP systems, workflow tools and digital solutions to improve efficiency. • Conduct root cause analysis of operational issues and implement corrective actions. • Support migration, transitions and process transformation projects as assigned. 10. People Coordination & Team Support • Coordinate, guide and support finance operations team members in daily execution. • Support a collaborative, service-oriented and customer-focused team culture. • Provide input to performance discussions, coaching and development planning. • Support cross-training, knowledge sharing and capability building across finance operations processes. • Support resource planning and workload coordination to meet service commitments. Minimum Job Requirements • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline. • 5–7 years of relevant experience in finance operations, transactional finance processes and service delivery within a shared services or high-volume operations environment. • Good command of English; proficiency in Cantonese with ability to read Chinese • Experience in team coordination, work allocation and operational performance support within a finance operations or shared services environment. • Prior supervisory exposure is preferred. • Knowledge of ERP systems such as Oracle, Coupa, Workday, OneStream or equivalent.

review_candidates.description: C. Steinweg France est une entreprise spécialisée dans le transport international, le transit, le stockage et l’entreposage. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans l’organisation et le suivi de leurs flux de marchandises en France et à l’international. Notre activité s’appuie sur trois sites en métropole et deux sites à La Réunion, avec une équipe d’environ 80 collaborateurs intervenant dans différents métiers : exploitation, douane, logistique et manutention, commerce, fonctions support et direction. Notre organisation à taille humaine favorise la proximité entre les équipes, la réactivité opérationnelle et la coopération entre les différents services. Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité à La Réunion, nous recherchons un agent ou une agente d’exploitation aérien capable de traiter et de suivre les dossiers de transit aérien import et export avec rigueur et réactivité. Vos missions Rattaché(e) au Responsable Exploitation, vous prenez en charge le traitement opérationnel, administratif et commercial des dossiers de transport aérien import et export, dans le respect des exigences clients, des procédures internes, des délais et des contraintes réglementaires et documentaires. Vous assurez notamment : La réception, l’analyse et le traitement des demandes clients relatives aux opérations de transit aérien import et export ; L’ouverture, l’exploitation, la facturation et la clôture des dossiers de transport aérien import et export ; La coordination des enlèvements, bookings, acheminements, livraisons et post-acheminements avec les compagnies aériennes, agents, transporteurs et prestataires ; La collecte, la préparation et le contrôle des documents nécessaires au bon déroulement des opérations ; Le suivi des expéditions et l’information régulière des clients et interlocuteurs internes sur l’avancement des dossiers ; Le contrôle des éléments de facturation fournisseurs et clients ainsi que le suivi de la rentabilité des dossiers ; Le suivi des retards, avaries, litiges, anomalies documentaires et autres aléas opérationnels ; La recherche de solutions en cas d’incident ou d’écart constaté et l’alerte des interlocuteurs concernés ; Le respect des procédures internes, des règles de sûreté, de sécurité et de qualité ainsi que des exigences liées au statut OEA et à la sécurisation de la chaîne logistique. Votre profil Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation de niveau Bac professionnel à Bac+2 en transport, logistique, commerce international ou d’une formation spécialisée équivalente. Vous disposez notamment : D’une connaissance du transport aérien international import et export ; D’une bonne maîtrise des opérations de transit, des documents de transport et des Incoterms ; De notions de douane, de réglementation transport et de contraintes documentaires ; D’une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, des TMS, de la messagerie et des outils de suivi et de cotation. La connaissance du logiciel CargoWise sera un plus. review_candidates.title: Remote Pod Lead - Math
review_candidates.description: About Turing: Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview: We are seeking an experienced Mathematics expert to lead a pod of 5–10 trainers developing realistic, terminal-based scientific and technical tasks for Terminal Bench Science. You will review trainer-created tasks for mathematical correctness, reproducibility, challenge, and grader reliability. You will also mentor trainers, manage quality and throughput, and ensure that tasks reflect authentic mathematical research and computational workflows. The role covers numerical and applied mathematics, scientific computing, optimization, statistics, mathematical modeling, computational algebra, and formal verification. What you’ll do: Review tasks end to end, including problem statements, datasets, environments, reference solutions, and automated tests. Verify mathematical correctness, well-posedness, convergence, stability, conditioning, discretization error, and edge-case handling. Ensure tasks require genuine multi-step reasoning rather than lookup or a single library call. Validate that exact, symbolic, arbitrary-precision, or floating-point computation is used appropriately. Check that tolerances are suitable for the problem’s numerical conditioning. Design and review graders based on mathematical properties such as residuals, feasibility, optimality certificates, invariants, error bounds, or proof checking. Ensure tasks are reproducible through pinned tools, libraries, solver versions, and dependencies. Identify and prevent hard-coded solutions, test-file leakage, and other methods of bypassing the intended computation. Provide precise, actionable feedback and track trainer revisions through closure. Mentor and onboard trainers on mathematical rigor, task design, coding practices, and evaluation standards. Allocate work, monitor quality and throughput, and escalate blockers. Maintain pod documentation covering guidelines, recurring issues, and exemplary tasks. Collaborate with the Mathematics Team Lead and other technical stakeholders to improve benchmark quality. What we’re looking for: Ph.D., postdoctoral experience, or equivalent advanced experience in mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics, or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python, Julia, C/C++, MATLAB/Octave, or a computer algebra system. Strong Linux and terminal proficiency. Hands-on experience with numerical methods, scientific computing, symbolic computation, optimization, computational statistics, or mathematical modeling. Ability to rigorously evaluate mathematical derivations, algorithms, proofs, and computational results. Experience reviewing research outputs, code, mathematical work, or scientific workflows. Experience mentoring or leading small technical or research teams. Strong written communication and the ability to provide precise, constructive feedback. Ability to assess reproducibility, test reliability, and the scientific validity of computational tasks. Nice to have: Experience with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy, mpmath, SageMath, PARI/GP, GAP, Macaulay2, or Mathematica-like workflows. Experience with FEniCS, Firedrake, DifferentialEquations.jl, PETSc, or similar ODE/PDE tools. Experience with CVXPY, JuMP, Pyomo, HiGHS, or other optimization frameworks. Familiarity with Lean/mathlib, Coq/Rocq, Isabelle, or other proof assistants. Experience with Docker, Git, CI systems, and automated testing. Experience designing benchmarks, competition problems, or computational evaluations. Experience evaluating AI coding, reasoning, or terminal agents. Experience setting or judging mathematics olympiad or competition problems. Publications or open-source contributions in computational mathematics, numerical software, or formalized mathematics. Prior experience in AI training, data generation, or model evaluation programs. Offer Details: Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 40 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST. Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 4 week [expected start date is next week]
